full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows a quiet suburban street at night under dense blue-green fog, with a pale car parked along the snowy far curb. The view is slightly elevated from the near side of the road, so the dark wet asphalt spreads across much of the lower frame and narrows toward the misty left distance. A rough bank of old snow, nearly black at its muddy edge, cuts diagonally across the lower left foreground. The parked car sits just left of center, seen from the side and rear. Its body is a subdued gray-white, and its small warm rear lights glow through the moisture. Short orange reflections from those lights stretch across the slick road beside a broader cold cyan sheen. Across the road, a thin level strip of snow covers the yards and sidewalk. Low single-story houses with shallow roofs and a few lit windows recede behind it, their rectangular forms fading as the fog becomes heavier to the left. A leafless tree stands near the right third, its fine dark branches spreading against the haze. A tall streetlamp behind it casts a round white-blue bloom and a soft descending cone of light over the snow, while a second dimmer lamp is barely visible farther back at left. Electrical lines run lightly across the upper middle, disappearing into the mist. The image has the restrained grain and softened contrast of night photography: edges remain legible near the camera, then dissolve gradually with distance. The shadows carry deep petroleum blue and green-gray rather than pure black; the lamps and windows supply small warm and cool luminous accents. The empty road, sparse structures, reflected lights, and blank fog make an ordinary residential scene feel suspended and still, with the car as a small solid anchor in the atmospheric depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形彩色照片呈现浓重蓝绿色雾气里的安静郊区夜街，一辆浅色车停在对面覆雪路沿旁。视点从道路近侧略微抬高，深暗湿沥青占据画面下方大部，并朝左侧雾中收窄。旧雪堆从左下前景斜切进来，沾泥的边缘近乎黑色。停着的车位于中心偏左，从侧后方可见。车身是低调的灰白色，细小暖色尾灯穿过潮气发亮。灯的短橙色倒影铺在光滑路面上，旁边还有更宽的冷青色反光。马路对面，一条薄而平的雪覆盖庭院与人行道。低矮单层住宅、浅斜屋顶和几扇亮窗排在后面，矩形体块越往左越消失在重雾中。右侧三分之一附近有一棵落叶树，细暗枝条张开在雾前。树后高高的路灯投出圆形白蓝光晕，一束柔光向下落在雪上；左侧更远处还隐约有另一盏暗灯。电线轻轻横过上部中段，逐渐消入雾里。照片有夜间摄影克制的颗粒与柔化对比：近处边缘尚可辨认，远处则慢慢溶解。阴影是深石油蓝和绿灰，而非纯黑；路灯与窗户提供小块冷暖亮点。空路、稀疏建筑、倒映的灯光和空白浓雾让普通住宅街景显得悬停而静止，小车则是大气纵深里一个微小而实在的锚点。
style_prompt_en: Color night photography is organized through dense atmospheric haze, subdued grain, and low contrast that softens with distance. Deep blue-green and petroleum gray occupy broad shadow areas, interrupted by a few small amber and icy cyan light sources. Moist reflective planes turn those points into short, blurred vertical streaks, while pale powdery surfaces hold a quieter diffuse glow. Nearby edges remain discernible and practical; finer lines and distant rectangular masses thin out into the fog. A broad dark foreground gives weight to the frame, with small illuminated forms set well back in layered space. The light is localized and haloed rather than evenly spread, leaving generous dim intervals that sustain a still, suspended mood.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色夜间摄影以浓密空气雾层、低调颗粒和随距离柔化的低对比组织画面。深蓝绿与石油灰占据宽阔暗部，仅被少量琥珀和冰青色光源打断。潮湿反射面把这些亮点拉成短而模糊的竖向光痕，浅色粉状表面则留着更安静的漫射亮度。近处边缘仍然清楚而朴素，细线和远处矩形色块在雾里逐渐变薄。宽阔暗前景给画面重量，细小发光形体退在分层空间里。光线集中在局部并带着晕圈，而非均匀铺开；宽大的昏暗间隔维持静止、悬停的气息。
theme_en: A parked car on a wet, snowy suburban street at night
theme_zh: 夜间潮湿积雪的郊区街道上停着一辆车
name: Todd Hido
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
